sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a tall round well inside a tower of bone-white stone whose stair has fallen up, broken steps hanging in the air along the wall. Low by the way in hangs an old bronze founders' bell with no clapper, and a stone ball has just rolled down a groove into its mouth and struck it, a clear note spreading in pale concentric rings of sound. In answer one great flat stone has come down from the top of the well to rest on the floor; high above, a door on a landing, a carved eye on the landing's face. A cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack steps onto the great stone before the bell falls quiet, dwarfed by the well. Small bells carved in niches, friezes of three dots over an upward arc. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, bone white stone, warm bronze, pale sky light, rose and lavender shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
